initial:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE landscape art-direction comparison board for a game's PLAYER TEXTURE approval. Three equal columns labeled only A, B, C. Warm ivory clean background. Large polished, immediately comparable full-body character front views in the upper two-thirds, each with a small matching rear three-quarter view seen steeply from above (62-degree downward game camera) below. Include one rectangular teal jacket fabric detail swatch and one tan backpack detail swatch in each column. Keep a tidy spacious layout; no decorative props.
Input image 1 is the exact existing character FRONT identity/proportions/clothing reference; image 2 is its exact BACK and backpack reference. Do NOT use their world background, shadows, lamp, health bar, terrain, game UI. These are reference images, not pixels to be composited.
Preserve the SAME existing blocky chibi survivor in every column: roughly 2.6 heads tall, large rounded-square head, two tiny vertical black pill eyes, dark brown hair under a rust-red cap with a short brim, small beige badge with simple return-home arrow and stitched square crown patch. Teal zipped work jacket with two small chest pockets, orange triangular neck scarf, two dark brown backpack straps, charcoal-blue straight trousers, brown simple work boots, mitten-like rounded hands, small ochre waist charm. Back: same compact tan/brown canvas flap backpack with single buckle strap, small return-home chalk mark and rust square repair patch. Do not redesign or add features, accessories, nose, mouth, eyebrows, big anime eyes, laces, pouches, silhouette embellishments. Uniform same standing pose, size, palette, neutral illumination, front view and anatomy in A/B/C; only surface drawing style changes.
A: CLEAN ANIMATION. Sharp clean matte 2–3-tone color planes, broad purposeful angular painted cloth shadows, just a few thin colored seam/fold strokes. No gradients or scratchy noise. Clear inviting animation background-paint aesthetic.
B: GRAPHIC COMIC. Same main colors, expressive dark colored interior ink-like fold contours and pocket edges, angular shadows, sparse short hatch accents ONLY in deep seams. Bold and characterful, not dirty. Stronger surface line rhythm than A. No added black outlines floating outside the model silhouette: linework should be fabric-painted texture details.
C: WARM STORYBOOK. Same palette but softer warmer large flat shapes, gentle irregular hand-drawn colored seams, very restrained broad dry-brush accents; flat gouache print feeling without grain/noise/mottling. Simpler and quieter than B.
Important: this is texture treatment concept art, not a model redesign, not a UV atlas, not a finished Unity render. Keep equal feature shapes, head/body ratios, outfit, camera, cap/backpack patch locations across the three columns. Emphasize that the fabric itself has drawn shapes and lines. No glossy clay look, no photorealistic fabrics, no exaggerated specular or glow. Legible only A B C typography, no other text, no watermark. High-quality cohesive professional comparison board.
revision:
Edit this comparison sheet in place. Preserve all column layout, A B C letters, exact character size, pose, clothing silhouette, eye placement, outfit colors, badges, and corresponding detail swatches and small rear figures. Targeted correction: the three choices need MUCH clearer texture-art differences, removing the reference's polygon camouflage everywhere.
A: repaint ALL surfaces including the red cap with truly clean animation key-art color planes. Each material gets only one flat opaque base, one crisp broad contiguous shadow shape, and at most one small simple light plane. NO polygon facets, no triangle mosaic, no painterly mottling, no gradients. Very few purposeful garment crease lines, colored rather than black. The jacket swatch must be an extremely clean teal flat pocket with simple dark seam and single planar shadow. Skin flat with one subtle broad under-cap shadow and two pill eyes; no eyebrows or hatch marks.
B: retain the expressive comic interior seams and linework, but replace small triangle mosaic texture with clean broad angular color fills. Hatch accents only under cap brim, at cuff, bottom of backpack and deep folds; no all-over scratches, no facial hatching. Vary line weight for pockets/fold joints. The graphic comic feeling should come from designed lines and broad graphic shadows, not a lowpoly wireframe. Same painted panel treatment on backpack and fabric swatches.
C: visibly softer and flatter storybook printed gouache look. Broad softly irregular opaque color masses with gently scalloped color boundaries. Very reduced shadows, no faceted triangles anywhere, no glossy sculpted clay shading, no tiny brushnoise. Nearly no dark linework; seam details represented by a slightly darker colored short stroke. Cap and backpack patches and existing arrow badge remain. Warm subdued colors, maintain teal not green.
Apply these changes consistently to full body, rear small figures and all swatches. No new features. No black outlines outside silhouettes. This is an illustration texture concept board, not a photograph.
